newsitem.title: HONG KONG: APT signs transponder deal with China.
newsitem.headline: APT signs transponder deal with China.

text.p: APT Satellite Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it had signed an agreement to lease China Broadcasting Film Television Satellite Co Ltd one of its Apstar-1A transponders.
The transponder broadcasts to households in China's southwestern province of Yunnan, APT said in a statement.
China Broadcasting Film Television Satellite is a subsidiary of the Ministry of Radio, Film and Television, it added.
It gave no details of the lease agreement.

About 80 percent of the transponders on Apstar-IA, launched in July 1996, were leased, APT said, adding that it expected All of the transponders on APT's first satellite, the Apstar-I launched in July 1994, were fully subscribed, it added.
APT plans to launch the Apstar-IIR in mid-1997 on a Chinese Long March 3B rocket. A Long March 3B rocket carrying an Intelsat satellite exploded in February 1996.
